drhp.business: Krebs Biochemicals & Industries manufactures pharmaceutical products using niche fermentation, bio-catalysis and chemistry capabilities, largely on loan-license/contract manufacturing arrangements. It operates two multi-purpose manufacturing facilities and leverages the marketing reach and forward-integration potential of its promoter group company.
drhp.expansion: No new capacity project, commissioning or expansion plan is disclosed in this bundle. The Company's Vizag (Unit-II, Anakapalli) manufacturing facility has been closed since 9 February 2025 under an Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board order, and management is working to get the closure revoked; the Company is separately exploring manufacturing additional fermentation-based products to better utilise its existing two-unit capacity (Nellore Unit-I and Anakapalli Unit-II) rather than adding new capacity.

litigation.note: The Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board issued a closure order (dated 7 February 2025, effective 9 February 2025) for the Company's Vizag manufacturing unit for alleged violation of consent-to-operate; as of the report date the stop-production order remains valid and unrevoked, and the Company is taking steps to get it revoked — read in the MD&A / Directors' Report / Secretarial Audit Report sections.
